top_band: grey tiled flat roof with parapet and rooftop HVAC/skylight units, rows 0 to 44
evidence: The building has a clearly visible foreshortened flat roof at the top (rows 0-44) complete with an inner parapet wall cast shadow, roof tiles, an AC unit, a vent, and a skylight all drawn in 3/4 view, followed by a bright front parapet edge (rows 42-44), green trim and eave shadow (rows 45-53), and a 4-story vertical south facade (rows 45-191) with recessed windows and entrance.

style.evidence: The building features rich plaster/brick speckle across the entire facade and roof tiles, 5-6 value steps on the grey masonry and blue-teal window glass, dark material-toned outlines, and recessed window frames with diagonal reflections that match the density and craft of the Beodeul reference buildings.
